correctness.rationale: For t!=±2 the branch polynomial is separable of degree 12 and genus is 5. The exact standard Hasse--Witt matrix is diagonalized by a constant F13-basis; the eigenvalues factor as one nonvanishing, two copies of (t+2)^3 P(t), and two scalar multiples of Q(t). Constant-basis diagonalization ensures the stable Frobenius rank equals one-step rank over any algebraically closed field. P and Q are disjoint, separable cubics avoiding ±2, with six roots in F169; Cartier kernel dimension is g-rank. Direct standard-library polynomial and F169 checks reproduced all critical identities.

value.rationale: The 2026 large-automorphism classification singles out this one-dimensional genus-five family but does not identify its nonordinary fibers. The theorem exhaustively identifies the natural smooth p-rank-three divisor, proves all drops occur in paired directions, and shows the determinant vanishes doubly at six distinct geometric parameters. This gives fine Jacobian-stratification data not implied numerically by the known automorphism or elliptic-isogeny descriptions. The classification is exact for its full parameter domain, not a random sample or arbitrary chosen curve.
